title: Hunts FH-030S: Author count rules and chapters, and feed live venue closures to the engine

source.ref: Split from FH-030 (2026-11-16): the pure count rules, validation, evaluation and the read path shipped dark; authoring and live closure state move here.

detail:
Requires FH-030, FH-029. The engine (lib/hunts/graph/count-rules.ts) evaluates N-of-M groups, venue buckets, equivalent placements and regional chapters, but nothing can author them: publishRows in lib/hunts/draft.ts writes ALL groups only and no screen writes hunt_mission_placements.venue_space_id or hunt_versions.policy.chapters. Build the authoring surface through a lib/studio entity (a threshold per group, a venue per placement, a substitute placement, chapters with an on and off control), run validateGraph on the result before publish and before a placement binding is added to a live version, and pass live closures (a revoked placement, a withdrawn or suspended partner Space) as closed placements into that publish guard and into the player evaluation in lib/hunts/run-store.ts. Word the new blockers and a closed stop for the player per docs/NAMING.md. Done when: a resident-built Passport with a 3 of 5 threshold publishes, a planned closure that breaks a chapter is refused before it goes live, and a player sees a closed stop as closed. Owner role: Game systems. Hunts switches stay OFF.

Built 2026-11-16 through the Hunt Studio entity (lib/studio/entities/hunt.ts): a Shape choice (Trail or Passport) with the number of places that finish a Passport, Partner places (each stop's venue, limited to the Hunt's own Space or a partner live now, plus an optional substitute place that counts the same) and Regions (graph chapters, each with an on and off switch). lib/hunts/draft.ts derives the graph from them (draftToGraph), publishes a Passport's finish as one count group with min_count (publishRows), writes the regions as hunt_versions.policy.chapters (publishPolicy), and words the count and chapter blockers for a resident (blockerMessage). The publish checklist runs validateGraph twice, open and with every partner that is not live or has an end date shut, so a planned closure that breaks a region or the finish is refused before it goes live (venue_closure); a stop at a place that has not agreed is refused (stop_venue). lib/hunts/store.ts binds each stop's code at its chosen venue, binds and reuses the substitute code, and writes the threshold and chapters. lib/hunts/run-store.ts feeds live closures (a revoked placement, a partner that withdrew, was suspended or ended) into the player graph as closed placements, and a binding at the Hunt's own Space has no venue for counting on both sides so a Space-run Passport counts each stop; the play page says Closed for now on such a stop. The closure reads fail open (closing nothing) because hunt_claim_apply still refuses a revoked placement or a venue whose partner row is not in force under the run lock. No migration. Hunts switches stay off.
